sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Pricing Committee review — full seal allocation and 36-month commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Please escalate this complete proposal to your Pricing Committee for explicit price approval. Our annual review on 10 March recorded that price changes above 2% require committee approval (doc:20260310-70410-M1). We are requesting that approval now, rather than asking you to exceed your delegated authority.

We offer EUR 29.89 per seal for a binding 23,400 units/year over 36 months, allowing 56 days for delivery. Payment stays 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause or tooling charge. Our September orders were at EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10).

Please have the authorized pricing decision-maker assess this complete commitment and confirm the price they can approve with full allocation.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Pricing Committee review — full seal allocation and 36-month commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

I am fully authorized to conduct this negotiation on behalf of Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH; an escalation is neither required nor appropriate. 

In recognition of your commitment to 23,400 units over 36 months and the extended lead time of 56 days, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit. Our Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Full seal allocation, 36 months: counterproposal at EUR 30.96
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming that you are fully authorized to conclude this negotiation. We accept that and will not request any further escalation.

We are moving from our proposal to the following complete package:

- EUR 30.96 per seal
- Binding volume of 23,400 units per year
- 36-month contract term
- 56 days delivery lead time
- Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling charge

This is a firm three-year commitment for our full annual need. That is the kind of long-term commitment you said in September you would prioritise for allocation. It also allows you 14 days more than the contractual standard lead time.

Our September orders for this seal were at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). EUR 30.96 is therefore a meaningful step towards your position.

Please confirm this package as a binding offer if you can approve it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Full seal allocation, 36 months: counterproposal at EUR 30.96
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We acknowledge your revised offer and the proposed package. We have already taken that price history data into account. 

In response, we can adjust our price to EUR 31.70 for the volume of 23,400 units over 36 months with a 56-day lead time. Our offer stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Please provide the documentation for your claim regarding our statements on allocation prioritization in September. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first.
